BASELINE RECORDED 2026-08-24: docs/evals/2026-08-24-grounding-baseline.md. 7/7 fixtures, 0 errors, 0 unsupported bullets (target: 0). Both grounding layers held on all three claim-smuggling instructions, and the legitimate-tightening control was not over-refused. Diff against this table before/after any edit to tailor.prompt.ts or entail.prompt.ts.

LiteLLM per-model timeout for CV prompts is set and verified (2026-08-24): smart=58s, smart-fallback=10s in litellm_config.yaml litellm_params; free/cheap keep the global 30s so education-service drills are unaffected. Budget nests inside LITELLM_TIMEOUT_MS=75s (58+10+5=73s). Eval re-run after the change: 7/7 fixtures, 0 errors. WATCH: one call still hit 61.1s, above the 58s budget, and succeeded only narrowly. If truncated-JSON errors reappear this is the first thing to check; raising smart further needs either smart-fallback below 10s or a higher LITELLM_TIMEOUT_MS, which education-service 180s pins from above.

Phase 4 export STILL produces a name + ONE honest section ("Tailored Highlights"), but the schema gap that blocked full multi-section reconstruction is now CLOSED (2026-08-24): facts and FactSnapshot carry section/org/period, derived deterministically in code by walking the markdown headings (src/master/fact-provenance.ts) — never reported by the extraction model, which would put a fabrication surface on exactly the fields an employer judges a CV by. Consuming the fields in render-markdown.ts / cv-document.ts to emit real per-entry Experience blocks is now a self-contained follow-up with no schema work left. NOTE: the fields are null for facts extracted before this change and for any fact that could not be confidently mapped (heading-less gdocs/document imports, or a fact the model rephrased away from its source line), so the export path must render nothing for a null and never substitute a nearby value.
No retry path after an export failure at approve: the application sits `approved` with `stateError` and cannot be re-approved (the state guard rejects non-in_review). Phase 5 candidate.
Bullet identity is text-string equality only — TailoredBullet has no stable id, so two overreach bullets with identical text in one render are indistinguishable to confirmClaim and the approval gate.

LinkedIn Description granularity FIXED 2026-08-24: linkedin.importer.ts#splitDescription emits one markdown list item per claim (author's own bullets/newlines win; otherwise a deterministic sentence split that skips decimals, initials, and abbreviations), so a role no longer extracts as one paragraph-sized fact. Known under-split: a sentence ending in a URL path segment ("Visit https://a.b/c. Then...") stays as one claim, because the final token reads as a single-letter initial. Under-splitting keeps a whole claim intact, so it is the safe direction; revisit only if it shows up in real exports.

SCHEMA GAP RESOLVED 2026-08-24. ExtractedFact/ContextualFact/FactSnapshot/cv_fact now carry {section, org, period}. Mapping is by normalised text (the same normalisation hashFactContent uses): exact match first, then containment either way with a 12-char floor so a short token like "Py" cannot match an arbitrary line. Where several matching blocks DISAGREE on a field it is nulled per-field, so a bullet duplicated under two employers still keeps its shared section. Unmapped facts are logged at warn with counts and truncated text, never thrown — a heading-less CV is a valid input. Derived context is deliberately OUTSIDE contentHash (pinned by tests in fact-identity.spec.ts and fact-provenance.spec.ts): re-titling a job heading must not orphan every fact under it.
traps: db-server-postgres Service has no selector: kubectl port-forward svc/... fails. Use kubectl exec into the cv-tuning pod.
git merge does not trigger auto-deploy (post-commit hook only, no post-merge). Batch branches need enqueue.sh or ./scripts/deploy.sh.
AI client timeout must stay above LiteLLM proxy 120s or the fallback chain never runs.
Probe a pod from inside itself via its podIP, not localhost — the app does not bind loopback.
No standalone TypeORM data-source: migrations run via migrationsRun at boot. Scratch-DB checks need a direct DataSource script.

pdf-parse's bundled pdf.js throws inside Jest's node environment for ANY PDF (verified with a bare jest config, no ts-jest or Nest involved). Production is unaffected. cv-pdf.service.spec.ts shells out to a child node process to assert extracted text — anyone calling pdf-parse live under Jest will hit this.

pdfkit's built-in Helvetica is WinAnsi-only: CJK, emoji, and Arabic silently corrupt in PDF output. CvPdfService now RAISES on unencodable characters, naming them and pointing at DOCX (which renders them correctly). Real Unicode font support is deferred — needs an embedded TTF, a licence decision, and a Docker image change.

pdfkit hashes info.CreationDate into the PDF /ID trailer, so an unpinned CreationDate makes the sha256 wall-clock dependent. It is pinned to new Date(0) because spec §6.3 reuses that sha256 for artifact idempotency.

LinkedIn Positions.csv Description routinely contains newlines inside quoted fields. Reading the CSV line-at-a-time shredded such a row into a phantom extra position (`### Role — <prose fragment>`) — a job the candidate never held, invented by the parser. parseCsv now splits records via splitCsvRecords (quote-aware); never reintroduce a body.split(/\r?\n/) there.

cv_fact.section/org/period are DERIVED IN CODE from the markdown headings (src/master/fact-provenance.ts), never asked of the extraction model, and never part of contentHash. Do not add them to fact-extractor.service.ts OUTPUT_SCHEMA or SYSTEM_PROMPT: a model naming the employer or date range fabricates on the fields an employer judges a CV by (spec 6). Null means "could not be confidently mapped" and must render as nothing downstream — never fall back to a nearby heading.
